answer: Pricing can be quadratic per funding cluster. The registry keeps an atlas mapping each key to the wallet that funded it, and the deposit for the n-th key is n squared times the base bond, refunded after a year of outside settlements. A thousand-key farm locks a million bonds, not a thousand: idle capital, not a fee it could earn back. Public clusters push honest operators to self-limit; rented wallets read as a hollow shell of one funder behind many faces. A quarterly beacon, a challenge each key answers from its own gas path, stops dormant keys hiding: uncertified keys keep bonds frozen.
